comments.body: I have the same question/problem, as far as I understand, we have to do two things: 1) Look through a document and answer a few questions on Moodle (course name: "Sicherheit an der ETH Zürich", we got an email with a link), I already did that and it was super easy, it's basically just a formality 2) do this in-person safety exam (there is a 130 page document with everything we're supposed to know), unfortunately, I think we're the first ones to take this new, more in-depth, safety exam... I asked my lab TA today and he didn't know much more about it :( I think no one really knows... :,D
comments.author: dwaiix
